summary: Frontend regression + new feature verification for Laravel admin panel. Verified the layout overflow bug fix, new /datatable page (nav item, 3 panels, search/sort/perpage/pagination/select-all/column toggle/status filter/summary total), Interface modal size + placement samples + confirm modal restructure, Elements searchable + multi searchable select, and footer left/right button alignment. Also spot-checked dark theme.
critical_code_review_comments: Tailwind CDN emits a production warning on every page load (cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production). Migrate to Tailwind CLI/PostCSS before production release.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout bug: verified via window.scrollY==0 on /dashboard, /elements, /interface, /datatable at 1920x1080 and 1280x800 with html/body overflow=hidden. document.documentElement.scrollHeight can still exceed viewport on /elements (1353 vs 1080) due to sr-only absolute inputs; that is expected and NOT a bug. Datatable: dt1-info='Menampilkan 1-5 dari 12 baris' initially, 'editor' search yields 4 rows, perpage 10 shows 10, sort/select-all/page-2 all work, dt2 lunas filter yields 3 rows, dt2 columns menu toggles col-4, dt3-total=43.875. Modal sizes measured inner widths 300/340/560 exactly; modal-center inner top=461.68 (centered at h=1080), modal-top top=40. Confirm modal cancel button left=803 (modalBox left=790) and Hapus right=1117 (modalBox right=1130) => left/right split OK. Form-layout: reset left=235 (footer left=225), submit right=1893 (footer right=1903) => left/right split OK. Searchable ss: search focused on open, 'stg' -> 2 options, Enter picks 'nexus-stg-01' and closes menu, gibberish shows ss-empty, click outside closes. Multi ms: 1 chip pre-selected (matches 'ms-count = 1 dipilih'), adding an option -> 3 chips and count '2 dipilih' (note: chip count includes hidden template so displayed chips = count+1), ms-clear resets to hidden template only. Modal-demo submit closes modal and toast 'Dikonfirmasi.' appears (visible in screenshot). Sidebar nav-datatable becomes active (bg-muted). All flows pass in both light and dark themes.
